import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from virtua import PatientAppointment, WorkflowSystem, Chemist, Lab, MachineLearningAlgorithm, Database

class TestPatientAppointment(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_patient_appointment_creation(self):
        patient_appointment = PatientAppointment()
        self.assertIsNotNone(patient_appointment)

    def test_workflow_system_design(self):
        workflow_system = WorkflowSystem()
        self.assertIsNotNone(workflow_system)

    def test_routing_to_chemist(self):
        chemist = Chemist(pincode="12345")
        patient = Patient(pincode="12345")
        self.assertEqual(workflow_system.route_to_chemist(patient, chemist), True)

    def test_routing_to_lab(self):
        lab = Lab(pincode="67890")
        patient = Patient(pincode="67890")
        self.assertEqual(workflow_system.route_to_lab(patient, lab), True)

    def test_machine_learning_algorithm_design(self):
        machine_learning_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()
        self.assertIsNotNone(machine_learning_algorithm)

    def test_machine_learning_algorithm_training(self):
        machine_learning_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()
        machine_learning_algorithm.train()
        self.assertTrue(machine_learning_algorithm.is_trained())

    def test_database_maintenance(self):
        database = Database()
        self.assertIsNotNone(database)

    def test_patient_archiving(self):
        patient = Patient()
        patient.archive()
        self.assertTrue(patient.is_archived())

    def test_consultation_requests_generation(self):
        workflow_system = WorkflowSystem()
        self.assertEqual(workflow_system.generate_consultation_requests(), 25000)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
